result.prose: Round 1 ran 200 ticks. The match continues. The Ledger settled and credited you $ 95, your Basic Minimum Income at band 1 (-5 %). The award fund pays out from S4, when there are awards to split it by. This match so far you destroyed no enemy assets and lost no assets. Licence awarded: Resonance Spire.
